articles.title: ETH crash to $1K looms if key support breaks: Will futures traders step in?
articles.snippet: Ether’s futures open interest fell by 25%, putting pressure on the $1,500 support level. Is a drop to $1,000 next?

Hyperliquid releases progress map, leads to speculation of next airdrop. Nike announced it has sold off RTFKT; Clone X jump 250%.
